roster = ["PCTY", "PAYC", "PAYX", "ADP", "WDAY", "TYL", "VEEV"]
COLS = {
  "income_statement": "date,fiscalYear,period,revenue,grossProfit,ebitda,operatingIncome,netIncome,sellingAndMarketingExpenses,researchAndDevelopmentExpenses,sellingGeneralAndAdministrativeExpenses,depreciationAndAmortization",
  "cash_flow": "date,operatingCashFlow,capitalExpenditure,freeCashFlow",
  "key_metrics": None,
}

def data_rows(payload):
  return payload["data"] if isinstance(payload, dict) else payload

def pct_of_rev(value, rev):
  return float(value) / rev if value is not None and float(value) > 0 else None

def multiple_flag(m):
  return "N/M" if pd.isna(m) or m > 100 or m < 0 else "OK"

async def pull(symbol):
  parts = await asyncio.gather(*(
    hank.acall("fetch_financials", endpoint=ep, symbol=symbol, period="annual", limit=5, **({"columns": cols} if cols else {}))
    for ep, cols in COLS.items()
  ))
  return symbol, [data_rows(p) for p in parts]

raw = {}
out = []
for symbol, (inc, cf, km) in await asyncio.gather(*(pull(s) for s in roster)):
  raw[symbol] = (inc, cf, km)
  for i, c, k in zip(inc, cf, km):
    assert i["date"] == c["date"] == k["date"], (symbol, i["date"], c["date"], k["date"])
    rev, ebitda = float(i["revenue"]), float(i["ebitda"])
    fcf = float(c["operatingCashFlow"]) - abs(float(c["capitalExpenditure"]))
    out.append({
      "ticker": symbol, "fy_end": i["date"], "fy": i.get("fiscalYear"), "revenue": rev,
      "gross_margin": float(i["grossProfit"]) / rev,
      "ebitda_margin": ebitda / rev,
      "op_margin": float(i["operatingIncome"]) / rev,
      "fcf_margin": fcf / rev,
      "fcf_conversion": fcf / ebitda if ebitda > 0 else None,
      "sm_pct_rev": pct_of_rev(i.get("sellingAndMarketingExpenses"), rev),
      "rd_pct_rev": pct_of_rev(i.get("researchAndDevelopmentExpenses"), rev),
      "capex_pct_rev": abs(float(c["capitalExpenditure"])) / rev,
      "ev_ebitda": k.get("evToEBITDA"),
      "roe": k.get("returnOnEquity"),
    })
df = pd.DataFrame(out).sort_values(["ticker","fy_end"])
df["multiple_flag"] = df["ev_ebitda"].map(multiple_flag)
# revenue growth y/y within ticker
df["rev_growth"] = df.groupby("ticker")["revenue"].pct_change()
print(df.shape, list(df.columns), df.groupby("ticker").size().to_dict())
print("key_metrics keys sample:", list(raw["PCTY"][2][0].keys())[:60])
print(df[df["multiple_flag"] == "N/M"][["ticker", "fy_end", "ev_ebitda"]].to_string(index=False))
pd.set_option("display.width", 250)
print(df[["ticker","fy_end","revenue","rev_growth","gross_margin","ebitda_margin","fcf_margin","fcf_conversion","sm_pct_rev","rd_pct_rev","capex_pct_rev","ev_ebitda","roe"]].round(4).to_string(index=False))
